name: New Jersey
summary_text: The safest measured jurisdiction in the country: lowest per-capita killing rate in the state-by-state dataset (3.4 per 100k trans women/yr; 4 recorded deaths 2008–2025) — half the general US homicide rate — inside the Most Protective legal tier. Clearly above the national score 0.36.

sources.title: Safe States Don’t Make People Safer
sources.claim_summary: The Needle state-by-state analysis (16 July 2026) of TGEU Trans Murder Monitoring data 2008–2025 against state legal tiers: New Jersey records the lowest per-capita killing rate of trans women in the measurable states (3.4 per 100k/yr, 4 recorded deaths, every figure a floor) — against the general US homicide baseline — and sits in the safest-law group; the article's broader point is that legal tier and lethal risk do not sort together.

sources.title: Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026
sources.claim_summary: Anti-trans national legal-risk assessment map, July 2026 edition (Erin In The Morning): ranks all states' anti-trans legislative risk (Idaho newly "Do Not Travel" as fourth such state); places New Jersey in the Most Protective tier, with shield/refuge protections and the least hostile formal legal framework for trans people travelling or living there.
